NAME_EN: Hong Kong International Lighting Fair (Autumn Edition) 2025
LOCATION: Hong Kong Convention & Exhibition Centre (1 Expo Drive, Wanchai, Hong Kong)
DESCRIPTION_KR: 상업·야외·첨단 조명 및 조명 기술을 아우르는 조명 산업의 글로벌 플랫폼으로, 스마트 조명·연결형 조명(Connected Lighting) 등 최신 트렌드를 한자리에서 만나볼 수 있습니다.
DESCRIPTION_EN: A global sourcing and networking platform for commercial, outdoor and advanced lighting technologies, highlighting innovation in smart or connected lighting systems and showcasing wide-ranging lighting solutions under one roof.
TARGET_INDUSTRY_EN: Commercial Lighting; Decorative Lighting; Outdoor Lighting; Smart Lighting; Lighting Technology
